title: 6 product decisions before the design gate (G3)
detail: The design review needs these from you. Accept the recommended answer or change it.

items.q: The two-week strip is step 1 of option A's main journey but is sized for R1. Move it into the MVP?
items.rec: Yes, move ST-BK-15 into the MVP (+3 points, MVP 142).

items.q: The zone heat grid for Facilities: MVP or R1?
items.rec: R1. The MVP keeps the occupancy table and its Excel export.
The desk they booked most often in the last 60 days, at least 3 times; a tie goes to the most recent.

items.q: Can a closed office be reopened?
items.rec: Not in the MVP: closing is final; a reopened office is created as a new office.
Employees and contingent workers; external users are not copied.

items.q: Reminders at 09:45 go out in one burst. What must the mail sender handle?
items.rec: At least 300 mails a minute; confirm the customer's mail service allows it.
